tips.text: Rank up before buying anything; the rank-ups, blueprints and gilds all draw on one daily-capped standing pool.
Do conservation at night; Vasca Kavats pay 500, 1,000 or 1,500 by rarity, and one player capped the day in 10 to 15 minutes.
Use Loki with Rest & Rage, or Ivara's Sleep Arrow, so conservation captures never miss.
Farm Tusk Thumpers with a Resource Booster; they can cap the day in about 10 minutes and double the gem haul.
Sell spare Marquise Veridos, raw Tear Azurite and Esher Devar to Old Man Suumbaat for standing.
Skip the Mewan, Cyath, Dehtat, Dokrahm and Rabvee blueprints until you can make their Marquise Veridos and Fersteel Alloy.
Pair every strike with the cheapest Grip and Link; only the strike banks Mastery.
Take the Peye Grip with a Vargeet II Jai Link when you want a Zaw you will actually use.
Choose the one-handed Machete for Cyath; slide-attack Polearm builds fell off.
Avoid a very slow grip on Mewan; it is already slow, so leveling it twice drags.
Run Advanced Plague Star three times for most of the 10,000 standing; each run nets about 3,275.
Keep the stage 3 escort drone healthy with Volt, Wisp or a pre-placed Nova Wormhole.
Leave the Infested spawn pods in stage 4 alone; they feed the Hemocyte kill counter and shooting them slows the run.
Buy Exodia Contagion at Defender; it is the community's main reason to build a Zaw.
Build every strike together for the Mastery; the refined gems, alloys and standing cover them all at once.
Queue every part side by side; each is the same 5,000 cr and one hour.
Preview Strike, Grip and Link combinations on Hok's forge screen, even for parts you don't own yet.
Level both passes somewhere fast, like Elite Sanctuary Onslaught or Hydron.
Don't donate a rank-30 Zaw to Hok before gilding it; an ungilded one gives no Mastery.
Hand spare max-rank Zaws to Hok for Ostron standing once their gilded run to 30 is done.
Most people build Zaws for the Mastery or Exodia Contagion; Primes and Incarnons out-stat them now.
